# Fourth Review — Addendum 1: the Interior Spine Trace read end-to-end; the metric-selection adjudication; one erratum against the parent review
**2026-07-25** · same session as the parent review (DraftV1, this morning) · trigger: Will's invitation to close-read the spine trace, and his correction — "metric selection is not an open problem; it's antithetical to the ontology; the 05-29 reading is an artifact of its own attention-divided read" · method: full read of `interior_spine_trace_ActiveV12` (340 lines, all clusters), then the primary documents on the contested point (5-29 closing note in full; 6-02 §4.2/§4.3; 06-09 §§ on the uniqueness chain; 06-20 assessment-evolution; the Independent Referee Consolidated Verdict §5; 07-20 review §on multiplicity-first; 06-17 forward-directions; T2 §T2-note) · the update below is evidence-coupled, not accommodation — the trail is cited at each step, and the residue the documents keep is kept.

## E1 — Erratum against the parent review (co-located per discipline; patch offered for DraftV2)

Parent §4 wrote: *"it must not be sold as a metric selection, which remains the named open floor (5-29 closing note)."* The recommendation (WYD as covariant instrumentation) stands unchanged; the **citation clause is wrong**, and it propagated a review-layer compression: the 07-22 and 07-24 reviews' repeated line — "5-29's bottom line remains the accurate one-paragraph description; nothing has moved the floor" — which I inherited without checking against the canon's own later adjudication. The canon had already moved the *name* of the floor:

> **06-20 `delta_external_assessment_evolution` [I1], high-σ, evidence-coupled:** "prior: metric-selection carried as live-open → new: **weak selection is closed** (framework content is package-invariant; the package is fixed per-application by the operative physics — 5-9 applicability-vs-application), and 5-29's 'O-C is the central open problem' is **a local statement that the same document marks out-of-scope-by-design**; only **strong selection** (deriving the operative package from first principles) remains, and it is **the forced-vs-chosen hinge wearing other clothes**."

Corrected sentence for the parent: *"it must not be sold as a metric selection — weak selection is closed (06-20 [I1]: package-invariance; per-application fixing), strong selection is the forced-vs-chosen hinge under another name, and the fiber's f-multiplicity is the shape axis the ontology treats as structure, not a candidate list awaiting elimination."*

## 1. The adjudication — Will's correction is substantively right, and the corpus's own documents carry the proof

**The internal tension is in 5-29 itself.** The closing note commits to Petz-first two paragraphs before framing O-8: *"the multiplicity of monotone metrics is the cornerstone… Chentsov uniqueness is its degenerate d≤2 terminus, not the foundation"* — and then: *"the selection of the physical metric at d≥3 is not fixed by the foundations, and that selection is where the genuine open physics lives."* If multiplicity is the cornerstone, demanding a foundations-level selection asks the framework to un-make its own cornerstone; a selection would collapse the shape axis — i.e., discard half of the very result (scale/shape) the note certifies as the defensible core. The note's §3 says it compresses by design; the "selection" sentence is where the compression bit.

**The documents that computed the load-bearing results resolve it the other way, consistently:**
- **6-02 §4.2 [VR in spine trace]:** the 2−√2 balance is family-universal because it lives on the radial structure the whole family shares — *"the Morozova–Chentsov non-uniqueness does not bite… **the Petz non-uniqueness is used as the structure** — you locate where the canonical pair coincide rather than picking a member."* §4.3 then locates the *actual* residual commitment: not selection within the family but the **embedding of the second metric**, fixed by the declared SU(1,1) budget coordinate — the residue is forced-vs-chosen, exactly as 06-20 renamed it.
- **5-30 open join (4), reframed live:** *"the non-uniqueness **is** the shape/fiber freedom that supplies the second direction; the weight sits on the family-invariant budget structure rather than any single metric's curvature."*
- **The axiom chain (06-09; Delta 7 §1):** the object is the space of accessible measures; the metric is an **output**; Petz relaxes commutativity, Campbell relaxes normalization — two orthogonal relaxations of the doubly-constrained Chentsov base. Under metric-as-output, "which f is *the* physical one" absent an interface specification is a category error, which is the precise sense of "antithetical to the ontology."
- **07-20 review (the mature external statement):** *"interface-relative geometry, scale-invariantly propagated, with an interface-invariant scale sector"* — with the observation that operational QIT already runs task-indexed (SLD ↔ symmetric Cramér–Rao; RLD ↔ Holevo; KM ↔ linear response; Lesniewski–Ruskai: the family = which divergence an agent uses), and that the corpus's *organization* of this (Campbell-radial ⊕ Petz-fiber) appears novel.

**Verdict.** "Metric selection" as a foundations-level demand is an artifact: 5-29 globalized a flag its own focused-core document had marked out-of-scope-by-design, its vocabulary contradicts its own Petz-first commitment, and every later computation that touched the point relocated the weight onto family-invariant structure. The review layer (07-22, 07-24, and my parent review) then re-cited the 5-29 sentence by inertia — consolidation prose trusted over derivations, the exact failure mode the 5-26 postmortem named, now exhibited at the reviewer stratum for a third time. The 07-24 review's "nothing in seven weeks has moved the floor" is true of the *floor* and false of its *name*: the floor is forced-vs-chosen; "metric selection" was retired from it on 06-20.

## 2. The residue, kept under its correct names (agreement without erasure)

Three things remain genuinely open, and none of them is "selection":
1. **Strong selection = forced-vs-chosen** — whether the budget/package is forced from first principles (6-2/5-30's shared deepest join; O-a/O-d/O-e). Untouched by this addendum, by the parent review, and by the rung-3 arc — as everyone has said all along.
2. **The interface dictionary** — tying specific f to specific physical interfaces *with numeric commitments* (07-20: "phenomena require tying f-selection to actual interfaces"). This is per-context instantiation work by design (5-9 applicability-vs-application), not a foundations gap. The completeness-reduction discipline governs: only specific numbers discriminate.
3. **The referee's held line, now answerable on its own terms.** The Independent Referee Consolidated Verdict §5 granted the family-invariant part but held: *"whether the angular Petz differences are genuinely gauge, **given the SLD's operational distinguishedness**"* — and correctly demanded resolution rather than a malformedness declaration. The parent review's GLMR fact supplies the resolution: the SLD's distinguishedness is **task-indexed** (optimal single-copy estimation), and there is now a second, equally sharp task-anchor on the *other* side — **preservation-characterizes-sufficiency holds for the WYD class and provably fails for SLD** (Gao–Li–Marvian–Rouzé, CMP 2024). With two members each carrying an exclusive operational distinction, the ontological reading of any one member's privilege symmetrizes away: the fiber differences are gauge *relative to family-covariant claims* and become content *exactly when a task/interface is specified* — which is the interface-dictionary posture, now with the referee's counterexample-shaped worry converted into its own best exhibit. (T2's proposal — "the physical metric is the one whose budget polarizes under native doubling" — is a third dictionary row in the making, and the WYD sweep is its instrument.)

**One named closure candidate [offered, could-fail]:** the **§L closure theorem**. §L's standing tag is "budget derived on the radial/commuting face (Tier 1); angular content open." Pre-register: *every axiom-chain-derivable scalar is family-universal* (the T2 radial-universality lemma is its first verified instance; 6-02 §4.2's balance is its second). Failure branch: exhibit one axiom-chain consequence that is f-dependent. If it survives, §L retires as *"the budget forces exactly the family-universal sector; the fiber is interface-indexed structure"* — the formal completion of the antithesis-of-selection posture, and the honest scope note is that "axiom-chain-derivable" must be pinned first (the O-a/O-d/O-e gaps live in that definition).

## 3. Spine-read yields for the parent review's two answers (brief)

- **Campbell (Q2) strengthened at the source:** 06-09 already states Campbell = *"a two-parameter family (Fisher–Rao plus a radial/total-mass term)"* — so P1's could-fail check (budget sectors transform as Campbell's A/B sectors under stick-breaking) has its exact target sitting in canon, and Campbell's theorem is itself the classical precedent for "invariance pins the form and leaves a family": a classification, not a selection. The proposal inherits the ontology cleanly.
- **WYD (Q1) re-grounded:** the p-dial is a coordinate on the **shape axis** — instrumenting the fiber freedom the ontology treats as structure. The GLMR partition (WYD-class in, SLD out) is itself family-*structure* (a covariant stratification by task), not grounds for choosing — the native restatement.
- **Namespace hygiene, three "embeddings":** (i) Markov/congruent embeddings (Campbell, Q2); (ii) the 6-02 §4.3 *metric-embedding* choice (the 2−√2-vs-2/3 fork, fixed by the SU(1,1) budget coordinate — forced-vs-chosen's territory); (iii) the WY √ρ *sphere* embedding (Q1). Three different objects, one word; the records should qualify on first use — the corpus has been burned by cheaper puns than this.
- Two smaller wires: 6-02 §11.2's observer-invariant **pq = ¼sech²(2η)** is the ancestor of T2's volatility identity [B1] (same Minkowski invariant, polarization dress); and the spine trace's own §G.3 line — *"structural content the same across the family; numerical content metric-dependent"* — is the one-sentence form of everything §1 above adjudicates.

## 4. On the spine trace itself, one paragraph of review

It earns its canon slot. The verification is real and adversarially disciplined (the located 5-18 algebra slip with the clean 2/3 prong; the O-4 collinear-deflation correction with the non-collinear Wigner angle reproduced to 1e-16; the Hodge conflation caught *in itself* and documented as a trap others fell into), the negative-space notes make the aliasing risk auditable rather than invisible, and the reconciliation flags (5-18↔6-1, 5-30↔O-4) are exactly the deferred-maintenance honesty most archives lack. Its one structural debt is the closing line's own: the "present-date reconciliation pass" it defers is now seven weeks deferred, and this addendum's §1 is a demonstration of the cost — an open-tag (metric selection) that later canon had flipped was still being cited as open by three consecutive external reviews. The Arch-spine refresh recommended in the parent review should include that reconciliation pass.
